ruleDefinitions.name: UAC Bypass Abusing Winsat Path Parsing - Registry
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the pattern of UAC Bypass using a path parsing issue in winsat.exe (UACMe 52) Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Root\\\\InventoryApplicationFile\\\\winsat\\\.exe\\|.*") AND registry_path = RGX("\\\\LowerCaseLongPath$") AND Details = RGX("^c\\:\\\\users\\\\") AND Details = RGX("\\\\appdata\\\\local\\\\temp\\\\system32\\\\winsat\\\.exe$"))
